description:
Job Description: 
 3+ years of experience in C#, SQL,  ASP.NET ,  JavaScript, JQuery 
 3+ years of Experience in development and testing web solutions across multiple platforms and browsers 
 3+ years of Experience developing test automation tools and frameworks. 
 3+  years of experience with testing frameworks such as Selenium WebDriver, Watin, QTP, Silk, SoapUI, Cucumber, 
 3+ years of experience in white box testing design, testing  techniques and unit testing with automation framework such as MSTest, NUnit, QUnit 
 3+ years of experience with REST/SOAP and API Testing 
 3+ year experience contributing to the improvement of automation test frameworks and infrastructure 
 3+ years experience designing and implementing test automation 
 Experience with full software development life cycle and software engineering best practices. 
 Experience creating test plans and test cases for complex systems. 
 Experience in QA process and testing methodology 
 Ability to adapt to changing priorities and technologies in a highly multi-tasked environment 
 Must be self-motivated and results driven, with attention to detail 
 Must have a hunger for knowledge and drive to increase product and domain expertise 
 Ability to effectively communicate and document technical concepts 
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills 
 Excellent problem solving and organizational skills 
 Experience using versioning software, TFS preferred 
 Experience working in a SaaS environment 
 Experience working in Agile /Scrum teams 
 Mobile experience is a plus 
 
 Education 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience


 6m contract to hire
 Only GC, EAD and USC. No H1s.
 

 This is a entry level - mid level (jr) level position.
